title: Redundant Buyer Identification
scenario: Find 'customer_id' who purchased the same 'product_key' more than once. Return 'customer_id'.
hint: Group by customer_id and product_key, filter where count > 1.
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id, product_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 5), (1, 5);
